_about: Which Bedrock model answers each kind of request when USE_BEDROCK=true. In each list the first ID is the default and the rest are fallbacks, tried in order when a model fails before any of its answer has appeared (for autopilot, also when its reply isn't usable JSON). A task left out uses BEDROCK_MODEL_ID. in.* profiles keep requests in India; global.* ones may be served from any region. region overrides AWS_REGION and stt overrides STT_PROVIDER. Restart Quip after editing.
